verses.text: Ha Jehová ix halan t'a Wajalil: Emanh k'ojan t'a in wach' k'ab' tik, masanto ol wak'kanoch heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach t'a yalanh ok, xchi Jehová.
Mamin Rey, a Jehová ol ak'an opisio yik tzak' yajalil t'a Sion masanto t'a slajwub' lum lum. Ol ak' yajalil t'a yib'anh heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach.

Ayik ol ak'an owal yet' heb' ajk'ool, ol ja heb' a chonhab', ol yak'anoch sb'a heb' t'a owal chi' het'ok. Icha yal ak'wal t'a k'inhib'alil, icha chi' ol aj sja heb' winh kelemtak t'a jun tzalan to iknhej yaji.
Yak'nak pax kan sti' Jehová, malaj b'ak'inh ol sk'exa', yalnak t'ayach icha tik: Sacerdote ach t'a masanil tiempo, icha yopisio winhaj Melquisedec, xchi.
Mamin Jehová, ayek' winh Rey t'a a wach' k'ab'. Ha t'a jun k'ual ol te kot yowal winh, ol satjokel heb' rey yuj winh.
Ha winh ol ak'an syaelal juntzanh niwak nación, ol cham anima, b'alb'umb'a ol aj heb' chamnak yuj winh. Ol satjokel heb' yajal t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik yuj winh.
Ha t'a yol b'e ol yuk'a' winh Rey t'a jun ha ha' sb'eyi, yuj chi' ol och yip winh.
